title: K1262b: λ × γ OAT market-microstructure sensitivity sweep
description: P5 Phase 2 confirmatory OAT addressing NotebookLM "70% threshold = λ/γ knife-edge artifact" critique. 5 OAT cells × 4 treatments × 4 adoption × 200 MC = 16000 sims. Confirms whether P5-style detector preserves VT 70% calibration AND TF/MR < VT ranking when kyle_lambda and vix_vol_sensitivity each perturbed ±50%.

config.detector: P5-style (Sharpe sign flip OR drop > 70% from 10% baseline)
config.seed_formula: int(adoption*100000) + sim_idx + 42 + scaling*1000 + window*10 + lambda_idx*100 + gamma_idx*10
